title: polystichum goldieanum
intro: Polystichum goldieanum, commonly known as the Golden Brake fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family of ferns. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Polystichum goldieanum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe irritated tissues and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
